source.description:
Portrait of Yao-Jen Chang

Yao-Jen Chang appears in a professional studio portrait wearing a light blue button-up shirt. He leans casually on the back of a white metal chair, his dark hair tousled and his gaze directed at the camera. The plain gray background emphasizes his relaxed posture and contemporary styling.

This image is featured on the IMDb media viewer page for Yao-Jen Chang, where it is titled and described simply with his name.

Chang Yao-Jen’s Reflective Portrait

In this professional portrait, Chang Yao-Jen appears seated against a plain, light-colored background. He wears a dark, textured sweater layered over a collared shirt, and his dark hair frames his face as he looks thoughtfully into the lens. The soft lighting accentuates his calm expression and the subtle details of his attire.
